evidence_scope: One true-cold 12 microsecond step per arm on the same frozen mesh and inputs for predictor-off passivity; predictor-on is a diagnostic arm, not healthy.

interpretation.limits: Exploratory one-step evidence, one mesh/input and solver build. Not validation, acceptance, or proof of full TEqn closure.
interpretation.predictor_off: At both selected initially pure-air cells, first UEqn predictor leaves U and K unchanged; T remains 293.15 K.
interpretation.predictor_on: At the first outer loop, unprojected UEqn produces Ux about 713 m/s and K about 254.18 kJ/kg before TEqn. Measured explicit ddt(rho K) corresponds to about -354.03 K over 12 microseconds; solved T falls by about 281.11 K, leaving about +72.92 K beyond the source-only estimate. This remains an unresolved remainder, not a closed energy budget.
interpretation.pressure: Raw pre-clamp minima and later sampled p-field minima are separate. Predictor-on has a raw 9.712 kPa contact, 282 cells below pMin, zero clipped water mass; the later sampled p-field minimum is 21.834 kPa.

observer_passivity_predictor_no.interpretation: Native output bytes directly test observer passivity for this same cold one-step case; this is not evidence about all solver versions or timesteps.
